title: Requirements
text:
Requirements
Prerequisites might be vary, based on the type and place of the first level (undergraduate) degree.
Roadmap for applying
Selection Process
Post-Acceptance Information
FAQ
Applicants are required to meet a number of other basic requirements in order to be eligible for admission.Based on the type and place of the first level (undergraduate) degree, different requirements might be in place.
The adjunct form/supplementary form is required with your application in C@mpus. Failure to include it can result in your application being rejected. The form can be found here.
For applicants with non-European first level degree (UC=NE)
(1) Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) degree or similar, e.g. BTech, BE, BCS, BCA but not B.A. Master degrees do not qualify and are not considered.
(2) min. 3 to 4 years regular study time
For applicants with a European (including German) first level degree (UC=E)
(1a) Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) degree or similar, e.g. BTech, BE, BCS, BCA but not B.A. or
(1b) Diploma Degree from an university of one of the European Union member states. Master degrees do not qualify and are not considered.
For applicants with German (Fach)-Hochschule/Berufsakademie (Duale Hochschule) Degrees (UC=E)
(1) Bachelor/Diplom Abschluss einer deutschen (Fach)hochschule oder Berufsakademie (Duale Hochschule), deren Abschlüsse denen einer Staatlichen Hochschule gleichgestellt sind
(2) entfällt
Note: [European] refers to the official member states of the European Union (EU)
The degrees of the awarding institutions have to be recognized as equivalents to those awarded by a german institution without restrictions. The institution should have a 'Status' of 'H+' in the anabin database of The Standing Conference of the German Ministers of Education (KMK).
An applicants bachelor degree should be in a similar field to ensure they have the foundation needed to suceed in the INFOTECH program. Eg. computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering (communications), electronics engineering or automation.
The Cumulative Grade Point Average/Overall Average (CGPA) should be better than (value/best on scale)
70%/100%
2.8/4
3.5/5
14/20
7/10
2.5/1.0 (for German Marks)
Original marks/grades are required, not a conversion to German grades. It should be noted that values close to these minimum values have a difficult position in the international competition for seats. In all cases the academic admission commission INFOTECH evaluates the finishing (overall) grades/marks of the degree examination and decides.
--READ THIS INFORMATION THROUGHLY--All applicants are required to provide proof of their English language skills before the application deadline. Applications without one of the accepted forms of proof cannot be considered for admission (ie. are immediately rejected).
Accepted proofs are (scores listed are minimums required - exceptions cannot be made):
TOEFL IBT 95 or better / from 2026: 5 or better TOEFL
IELTS band 7,0 or better (academic)
Cambridge C1/C2
Oxford Test of English Advanced (C1)
PTE Academic Score 76 or better
telc: telc University B2/C1 (result „very good“); telc C1 / C2 (general examination)
Medium of Instruction (MoI), e.g. certificate confirming your bachelor's program was taught in english is not accepted. Exceptions cannot be made.
Please note some certificates are only valid for 2 years (eg. IELTS). The uploaded certificate has to be valid at least until the application deadline (15th of January/July)
If you are a national with citizenship and education from one of the countries listed below - you can submit proof of citizenship instead of one of the language proficiency proofs (eg. passport). Applicants from countries not included in this list must submit one of the proofs listed above.
Antigua and Barbuda
Australia
The Bahamas
Barbados
Belize
Canada
Dominica
Grenada
Guyana
Ireland
Jamaica
Malta
New Zealand
St Kitts and Nevis
St Lucia
St Vincent and the Grenadines
Trinidad and Tobago
United Kingdom
United States of America
The APS certificates have to be submitted before the application deadline.
China, Mongolia and VietnamCertificate from the APS ("Akademische Prüfstelle"). Further information in APS.
IndiaCertificate from the APS ("Akademische Prüfstelle"). Further information : APS India.- As of September 2025, an APS certificate does not need to be submitted if:
The highest university degree relevant for assessment originates from a country other than India (For INFOTECH we assess your bachelor degree)
Proof that a previous assessment test has been passed is available
The applicant can provide proof they will be receiving a scholarship from Germany or the EU.
Use this link for for application C@MPUS.
Ensure the name you provide in C@mpus and in the Adjunct matches the name on your documents!!
Letters of motivation or recommendation are not required for the application.
A manual for application is available here.
If you have technical questions concerning C@MPUS please contact support@campus.uni-stuttgart.de.
